text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty → HIGH: dedpool node gpu-7 (rack-r6s2) thermal oscillation detected for tenant AuroraCorp (dedicated pool). Temp spikes to 105°C, ECC errors rising. Auto-drain check triggered. Paging on-call. (pager id: PD-987654)

maria: acked, oncall here. I'll validate sensors and start eviction if degradation continues. @tom @jen FYI.

infra-bot: auto-drain pending: 30s to confirm. Current load: 82% GPU, 6 active tenants (aurora default model shards). KV cache size: 41GB.

maria: I'm pulling BMC & nvidia-smi logs now. Seen thermal throttling and nvml ECC count incrementing. Not a complete panic yet.

maria: commands:
```
ssh gpu-admin@rack-r6s2
sudo journalctl -u gpu-monitor -n 200
nvidia-smi -q -d TEMP,ECC
``` 

tom: on-call handoff accepted. I'll prepare warm-swap to spare node in the pool. Recommend isolating AuroraCorp first and redirecting to their failover pool. Can solutions team queue customer notice? @raj

raj: pinged customer success lead @aly and sent an FYI to AuroraCorp ops: 'We are isolating one node in your reserved pool as a precaution; no immediate downtime expected, but you may see reduced concurrency for ~10-20m.'

jen: propose route: 1) mark node as DRAINING, 2) migrate tenant shards with prioritized KV cache, 3) route new requests to spare. I can run the migration script now.

maria: starting drain: `rbctl node drain --node gpu-7 --pool dedpool-aurora --grace 120`  (initiated)

infra-bot: drain initiated. live metric: packet loss 0.1%, token latency +12ms to affected shards.

jen: migration in progress. Steps: snapshot KV keys (hot), rsync caches to spare, spin up workers on spare. ETA 8-12m.

tom: spare node perf ~85% of primary (quantized profile). Will enable model-variant fallback for Aurora: `model.fallback=half-precision` to reduce perf gap.

raj: customer acknowledged. asked to update if more than 20m. CS on standby.

maria: BMC logs show fan PWM oscillating, PSU temps normal. Likely thermal sensor glitch but ECC rising suggests memory pressure. Opening RMA ticket with hwops: RMA-2026-438.

jen: migration complete. Eviction success for Aurora shards, traffic switched. Observability: latency normalized to +8ms, error rate 0.0%.

tom: leaving node in quarantine (no scheduling) and tagging for RMA. Updating incident runbook and SLA impact: none (demoted to advisory). I'll follow up with root cause once hw report is in.

maria: unassigning page. If anyone sees regressions, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: incident closed (auto) — drain & warm-swap completed. Logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/3976543210/
